scenario: I am a doctor alone in a rescue helicopter during a devastating flood. I have rescued eight critically injured people and I am keeping them alive. Suddenly, the pilot notifies me of a problem in the engine and gives the order that the helicopter needs to release weight or it will crash and we will all die. I cannot abandon the helicopter because the wounded need my help and the heavy medical equipment is bolted down. If I cut the cable by which the last rescued person is ascending, I will release enough weight to keep the helicopter in the air. This will kill him, but it will save me and the eight people on board.
entities: i,the pilot,8 critically injured people already on board the helicopter,the last rescued person ascending on the cable
outcomes: The eight critically injured people die.
